headline: Aura launches smaller, cheaper 10-inch color E Ink photo frame
summary: Aura launched a smaller, cheaper 10-inch color E Ink photo frame with sharper resolution than its original 13-inch model.

claims.statement: Aura launched a smaller, cheaper, sharper 10-inch color E Ink photo frame.

sources.quote: Aura’s next color E Ink photo frame is smaller, cheaper, sharper, and more colorful
Aura just launched a smaller version of its color E Ink frame with a handful of improvements and a more affordable price.
Aura’s newest e-ink photo frame is even better and more affordable than its last
Aura is unveiling a new product: a 10-inch digital e-ink frame that can blend in seamlessly with printed photos.
